name: camphor (-)-
purpose: Uses Temporarily relieve minor pain in joints such as neck, waist and legs.
uses: Directions Clean and dry affected area. Tear off the back paper. Stick to the affected area.
otcwarn: Stop use For people with skin allergy, skin ulceration, open wounds, dermatitis and eczema, and pregnant women, infants. If you experience itching, tingling or rash during use.
